task_title: Fix unclosed resource and missing exception handling in audio_loop
summary: Fixed two issues in audio_loop: 1) The KeyboardInterrupt handler now sets self.is_running = False before breaking, ensuring the shutdown path in run() triggers process_command('goodbye') cleanly. 2) The generic Exception handler now calls traceback.print_exc() for full stack trace diagnostics. Added 'import traceback' at the top of main.py to support this.
demo_script: Sir, I've fixed the audio loop shutdown handling. Now when you press Ctrl+C, the system properly sets is_running to False for a clean shutdown sequence. I've also added full traceback logging to the generic exception handler so any errors will be much easier to diagnose.

changes.description: Added 'import traceback' at top. In audio_loop KeyboardInterrupt handler, set self.is_running = False before break for clean shutdown. In generic Exception handler, added traceback.print_exc() for better diagnostics.
